modes.label: Mode
modes.comingSoonHint: This mode is not implemented yet. The 3D view still works.

start.tagline: runs in your browser · no account · STL and 3MF
start.title: What are you printing?

box.desc: Bin or tray on the Gridfinity grid, with lip, scoop and dividers.

baseplate.desc: Grid plate for your bins. Magnets, screws, split to fit your bed.

cutout.desc: Bin with a pocket shaped to your tool. Import an STL or use a simple shape.

size.title: Size
size.paddingNote: The leftover space becomes flat padding next to the cells, placed as chosen.

plate.title: Build plate
plate.oversize: The baseplate ({{size}}) is larger than the build plate ({{plate}}). Reduce the size or split it into parts.

error.size: Enter a size greater than zero
error.sizeTooLarge: Size is too large (up to {{max}} mm)
error.baseHeightMin: Not below the standard 4.65 mm profile
error.rimTooLarge: The rim leaves no room for the plate
error.radiusTooLarge: Radius is larger than half of the plate
error.tooManyCells: Too many cells along this axis
error.paddingDropTooLarge: Lowering is larger than the plate height
error.invalid: Fix the highlighted values: the preview shows the last valid model
error.splitCellTooBig: A single cell does not fit the bed, so the plate cannot be split.
error.splitTooManyParts: Too many parts (more than {{max}}). Use a larger bed or a smaller plate.

thickness.clearanceTooLarge: Clearance is too large for this cell size

sizeInput.truncated: Smaller than one cell: the cell is truncated.

fastener.title: Fasteners
fastener.nearEdge: {{kind}} hole {{n}} is closer than 0.8 mm to the edge.

editor.title: Placement editor
editor.hint: click a position to toggle it
editor.label: Fastener positions
editor.empty: Nothing selected. Click a position to add a hole and an ear.

fastener.floorNote: Fasteners add ears {{value}} high around the holes; the rest of each cell stays open.
fastener.earTooBig: {{kind}}: the ear of the hole does not fit inside the cell.

split.title: Split to fit bed
split.oversizeBanner: {{n}} part(s) exceed the bed ({{bed}}). Move the cuts or reduce the size; export is still possible.
split.single: One part: the plate already fits the bed

error.cellTooBig: A single cell does not fit the bed, so the plate cannot be split.
error.tooManyParts: Too many parts (more than {{max}}). Use a larger bed or a smaller plate.

connector.title: Connectors
connector.tooBigForRidge: Cut {{cut}} ({{parts}}): the hole is wider than the rib, so no connector was made.
connector.dovetailTooDeep: Cut {{cut}} ({{parts}}): the dovetail is too deep for the wall, so no connector was made.
connector.noRoom: Cut {{cut}} ({{parts}}): the edge is too short for this count and inset.
connector.collision: Cut {{cut}} ({{parts}}): no free place next to the fastener holes for a connector.
connector.effectiveDepthClamped: Effective depth: {{value}} (limited by the part length)
connector.noRib: Cut {{cut}} ({{parts}}): no rib ends on this face (it is one cell wide), so no hole was made. Use the dovetail or another cut.
connector.holesHelp: Holes go into the end of the rib that meets the cut, along the rib.

lip.title: Lip
lip.help: The lip is the rim at the top of the bin that mates with the foot of a bin stacked above it. None gives a flat top. The lip adds to the height.

compartments.title: Compartments
compartments.hint: Click a divider segment to merge or split compartments. Drag a divider to move it.
compartments.narrow: Compartment {{n}} is only {{w}} wide after the dividers.

notice.scoopClamped: The scoop radius is limited to {{value}} by the cavity depth.

error.height: Enter a height greater than zero
error.noCavity: Walls, floor and height leave no room inside
error.dividersTooThick: Dividers are too thick for this many compartments
error.invalid: Fix the highlighted values: the preview shows the last valid model
